Abh. 75 , compare Nö ZMG xxx(1876), 769 , but uncertain, compare Now and references); — plural [absolute!] הָרֶכֶב בְּאֵשׁמְּֿלָדֹת Nahum 2:4 < וגו מִּלְדֹת ׳כָּאֵשׁ We Now, like fire the steel (fittings) of the chariots .
